verdict.rationale: The only scoping evidence is environment separation: runs made with a test API key never touch production data and never fire production webhooks. That limits what an agent's credential can reach, but it is not permission-level least privilege. The authentication page is cited by title only, with no detail on key scopes. Missing for 10: per-key permission scopes (e.g., read-only or endpoint-restricted keys), agent-specific or per-resource credential issuance, key expiry/rotation controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
